title: Database Administrator/ SQL Developer
description:
### **Job Information**


* Date Opened 09/16/2026
* Job Type Full time
* Industry Automotive
* Work Experience 1\-3 years
* Salary 35k\-50k
* City New Delhi
* State/Province Delhi
* Country India
* Zip/Postal Code 110001
### **About Us**


Established in 1994, Atlanta Systems Private Limited has been a cornerstone in India's ICT landscape for nearly three decades. As a trusted leader in IoT\-GPS Telematics hardware products \& solutions, we have delivered over a million connected devices to thousands of users arounds the world, reflecting our unwavering commitment to quality and innovation. Our product range is designed to cater to diverse market needs, making us a preferred partner for our clients and channel partners alike.  

Our core strength is rooted in our in\-house expertise spanning hardware product conceptualization, design ideation and development, implementation of embedded systems, software development. In addition, we indigenously manufacture our products with the help of a state\-of\-the\-art SMT manufacturing facility, fully equipped with advanced quality control technologies and certified governance practices, ensuring the highest standards of product excellence and innovation.  

With a strong commitment to the Make\-In\-India initiative, we integrate certified governance standards to ensure excellence in every aspect of our operations. Our dedicated team of professionals drives our success, ensuring we remain at the forefront of industry evolution and transformation.  

### **Job Description**


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Develop, maintain, and optimize SQL queries, stored procedures, functions, views, and triggers.
* Design and manage database structures ensuring data integrity, security, scalability, and performance.
* Write complex SQL queries for data extraction, transformation, validation, reporting, and business intelligence needs.
* Perform database performance tuning, query optimization, execution plan analysis, and indexing.
* Support ETL processes, data migration, integration, and data transformation activities.
* Monitor database health, availability, backups, recovery processes, and security compliance.
* Troubleshoot database issues, performance bottlenecks, and data inconsistencies.
* Collaborate with developers, business analysts, and stakeholders to implement data solution.
* Maintain technical documentation and support database deployments, releases, and production operations.

### **Requirements**

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* 2–3 years of experience in SQL Development, Database Administration, or related roles.
* Strong understanding of relational database concepts and data modeling.
* Experience working with enterprise\-scale databases and reporting environments.

**Skills Required**
-------------------

* Strong proficiency in SQL programming.
* Experience with PostgreSQL, MySQL, Microsoft SQL Server, or similar RDBMS.
* Knowledge of Stored Procedures, Functions, Triggers, Views, and Indexing.
* Hands\-on experience in query optimization and database performance tuning.
* Understanding of ETL processes and data transformation techniques.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and data analysis methodologies.
* Familiarity with Power BI, Tableau, or other reporting tools is an added advantage.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills.

title: Office Administrator
description:
Job description: ADMIN FURNITURE DEPT Department: Administration Location: Okhla , New Delhi Salary: Based on experience and skill level Gender: Female / Male Qualification: Graduate Working Hours: 10:00 AM to 6:30 PM (some flexibility appreciated) Job Description Assist in client relationship management and sales coordination. Support business development and follow\-up for leads and client inquiries. Document meeting notes, maintain client records, and track follow\-ups. Help prepare basic MIS reports and internal communication as needed. Coordinate client visits and assist during sales meetings. Manage client data and update CRM/database regularly. Help prepare basic letters, forms, and reports using MS Word and Excel. Coordinate logistics for meetings, travel, and client\-related requirements. Key Skills \& Competencies Good verbal and written communication skills (English \& Hindi). Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook). Strong time management and coordination ability. Ability to maintain confidentiality and professionalism. Familiarity with basic admin tasks like data entry, filing, and scheduling. Comfortable using phones, tablets, and other basic electronic devices. Willing to learn and support across departments when needed Essential Technical Skills: The candidate must have strong working proficiency in both Microsoft PowerPoint and Microsoft Excel. These are core requirements for the role and are non\-negotiable. PowerPointThe candidate should be able to work efficiently and independently, including: ● Creating and formatting professional presentations. ● Cropping and editing images. ● Removing image backgrounds. ● Setting up and managing page layouts and slide formatting. ● Arranging visual content in a clean, organized, and presentation\-ready manner. ExcelThe candidate should be proficient and work with speed and accuracy, including: ● Creating and managing spreadsheets. ● Using formulas and performing calculations. ● Working confidently with numerical data. ● Importing and inserting images where required. ● Formatting worksheets and maintaining organized data. The candidate will be assessed on these skills during the recruitment process. Strong proficiency in both PowerPoint and Excel is an essential requirement for this position.

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹40,000\.00 per month

Experience:

* Admin Sales: 2 years (Preferred)

Work Location: In person
